run_train_one_epoch: run one training epoch of the MCC model with gradient accumulation and mixed precision
run_eval_one_epoch: run one evaluation epoch computing precision recall and F1 metrics for 3D point cloud predictions
run_run_viz: run visualization of MCC model predictions by generating HTML point cloud plots for a data loader
run_evaluate_points: run point cloud evaluation computing precision recall and F1 score between predicted and ground truth points
run_prepare_data: run data preparation for MCC training including point sampling augmentation and random flipping
